summary: A Yes vote extends the city's existing utility users tax.

tax.text: Yes on Measure II supports extending Union City's existing 5% Utility Users Tax to keep funding city services such as 9-1-1 response, fire protection, and street repair rather than let it expire.
tax.quote: Union City would lose approximately $7 million in annual funding and would have to consider cuts to city services.

tax.text: A No vote on Measure II opposes extending Union City's existing 5% Utility Users Tax, allowing it to expire at the end of 2028 rather than continuing through 2037.
tax.quote: the proposed Measure II would extend the expiration date from December 31, 2028 to December 31, 2037.
